meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会逐个完整读取项目里的每一个源文件(不论有多少个),并用 Read 工具的 offset、limit 参数把大文件分块翻完,以此建立对整个代码库的理解。
howto.when: 初次接触新项目或不熟悉的项目时,或你说「learn the codebase」「read the codebase」「prime」等说法时接管。

say.text: 帮我读一遍这个代码库,每个源文件都要完整读。
say.note: Claude 会逐个完整读取所有源文件。

say.text: 先熟悉这个项目再动手改代码。
say.note: 先建立代码库理解,再开始后续工作。

say.text: 大文件请用 offset 和 limit 分块翻页读。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads every source file in the project in full, no matter how many, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters to build an understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Learn this codebase and read every source file in full.
say_en.note: Claude reads each source file in full.

say_en.text: Get up to speed on this project before I change code.
Use offset and limit to page through large files.
